integrity: The half-graph scalar specialization Z^-(H_s)=0 is explicitly treated as prior coverage.
The first_public_date uses the independently verified exact online date of the foundational journal source; an earlier manuscript date is not treated as a verified public-release date.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for finite connected chain graphs; disconnected graphs with isolated vertices are outside the claim.
The computational verification is exhaustive only through order 10 and supplements, rather than replaces, the general proof.
Alternative older terminology such as Ferrers or difference graphs creates a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Skew zero forcing sets of chain graphs factor by twin classes
